rows.grounds: Gloss 'in-flowers-and-so-on'; puṣpa + ādi compound (dvandva/itaretara or bahuvrīhi context), locative plural of neuter ādi-compound.
Gloss 'in-a-child'; locative singular of masculine śiśu.
Gloss 'primary'; nominative singular masculine of mukhya.
Gloss 'consecration'; nominative singular masculine of saṃskāra.
Gloss 'in-such-Śiva-recognition'; compound (śiva + tādṛśa), locative singular neuter agreeing with context; membership: śiva+tādṛśa (tatpuruṣa/bahuvrīhi) — AMBIGUOUS as to exact compound type.
Gloss 'it-is-said'; past passive participle ukta < √vac, nominative singular neuter, used impersonally.
Gloss 'in-the-Yogasañcāra'; compound (śrī + yoga + saṃcāra), locative singular masculine; exact internal membership AMBIGUOUS.
Gloss 'by-the-Supreme-Lord'; instrumental singular masculine of parameśin.
